story.fullStory:
Guns N' Roses's "Paradise City" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Paradise City" is a song by the American rock band Guns N' Roses, featured on their debut album, Appetite for Destruction (1987).

Released as a single in November 1988, it is the only song on the album to feature a synthesizer.

The song peaked at number five on the Billboard Hot 100—becoming the band's third single to reach the top 10—and number six on the UK Singles Chart.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.
